Name: QTA - QEMU Timing Analyzer
Description: The QEMU Timing Analyzer (QTA) is a QEMU plugin which extends QEMU for the time annotated execution of binary programs. QTA has been tested only for RISC-V and TriCore. As the implementation extends QEMU through the TCG plugin API it should be compatible with any other ISA and future QEMU versions. QTA comes with a frontend that can import output files from AbsInt aiT WCET analysis.
Comment: Source code freely available at https://github.com/hni-sct/qemu-qta; contact wolfgang@acm.org.
